g.text: Compiler settings and matrix blocking: four process runs
2026-11-01 | MSVC x64 | source: Day 7 integrated version
Each algorithm, top to bottom: /O2 run 1, /Od run 2, /Od run 3, /O2 run 4
Time per multiply (ms, logarithmic scale) — lower is faster
Dots = five batch averages within each run; black tick = median of those five. No samples excluded.
Only two process runs per setting; frequency, background load and affinity were not controlled.
Timing includes clearing C; this does not measure cache misses or reproduce the historical executable.
